Rook & Ruin

Spitz Arcade

Slope-intercept form. Fight through The Crooked Keep, grow your powers, beat the Iron Warden. About 6 to 9 minutes.

1. FightArrows or WASD move. Space swings your sword. Shift rolls. Roll right as an attack lands for a Perfect dodge and a crit.
2. AnswerGems fill your level bar. After each room, two questions power up every level you earned. Right answers give more and better choices.
3. SurviveBeat the Iron Warden, then survive the 2-minute Last Stand. Combos and flawless rooms score big.
Keys: Arrows or WASD move · Space sword · Shift dodge · 1–4 answer · Enter next
N music · M mute · Shift+R new game · F full screen
